name: Magnesium
description: Dietary mineral, taken as salts such as bisglycinate or L-threonate; sulfate form is an injectable drug

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement · not a sleep drug

note.text: A 2026 review of 12 trials found inconsistent results and said the evidence does not support routine use for insomnia.

bullets: **Blocks NMDA receptors,** the reasoning given in trial papers
**Supports GABA signaling,** a brain system involved in sleep
These are proposed reasons for study, **not trial results**
**In people,** the sleep mechanism is not established
Injection FDA approved, for other uses
Sleep RCTs of 46 to 155 people, weeks long
Reviews: low to very low certainty

practical.routes: By mouth (sleep trials); injection for approved uses
practical.monitored: Insomnia scores, sleep logs, ring-based sleep scores

regulatory.text: Not approved for sleep; sold as a supplement
Sulfate injection approved for other uses

references: Lopresti et al., J Diet Suppl, magnesium for sleep (systematic review), Aug 2026
Mah and Pitre, BMC Complement Med Ther, magnesium for insomnia (meta-analysis), Apr 2021
FDA, Magnesium Sulfate Injection label (DailyMed), Feb 2026
